free_text: Despite the prior positive biopsy, the high PI-RADS 5 score and the significant PSA velocity of 2.45 ng/mL/yr indicate a high-risk scenario requiring further tissue characterization. The combination of the PI-RADS 5 lesion and rising PSA velocity places the patient in a high-risk category, which overrides the prior diagnosis. The room converged on proceeding with a biopsy to determine the current disease status and guide management.
